# Release check: 2026-11-28, v1.2.2

A fresh agent with no context installed v1.2.2 from GitHub, followed only the README and linked docs, and chose the Adyen Checkout API v70 from the [APIs.guru OpenAPI Directory](https://github.com/APIs-guru/openapi-directory): OpenAPI 3.1, 25 operations, about 630 KB, deep nested `oneOf` request bodies, Basic and API-key auth. It ran 101 deliberate breaks against validation, in two rounds, and ran the validator repeatedly in parallel to look for lost output. The spec is now a test fixture.

What worked: install, `init` and the CI step as documented; all 25 operations generated and passed validation as generated; the server URL, auth, parameter tables and nested request fields were right; the validator caught invented table rows and JSON fields, enum values outside the spec, wrong Required flags on top-level fields, wrong statuses, wrong paths and methods, wrong versions and empty frontmatter.

v1.2.2 failed the run on 59 of the 101 breaks. With the fixes below, 96 fail it. Of the other five, two replace `Needs SME input` with invented prose (out of reach for a format check; the SME-label warning count drops), two are not defects (an optional header left out of the example; an "invalid enum value" on a field whose schema defines no enum), and one ran in a folder with no owners registry, where there is nothing to check against.

| Finding | Outcome in v1.2.3 |
| --- | --- |
| Generated docs read Adyen's prose lists ("Allowed values: * `a` – …") as enums and failed their own validation | Fixed: the generator writes allowed values in backticks, and only that form, or a plain list at the end of a hand-written cell, is read as an enum |
| Missed: Required flipped on a nested field and on a field inside an array | Fixed |
| Missed: a number sent as a string, in the request, response and error examples | Fixed: every example value's JSON type is checked against the schema |
| Missed: a changed `Default:`, `Format:`, minimum or maximum note | Fixed, in Request Body rows and parameter tables |
| Missed: allowed values added to a field with no enum | Fixed |
| Missed: Error Codes row removed; invented field or wrong type in the error body; error body shown under a status the operation does not have | Fixed |
| Missed: the curl example sends a Bearer token, or a `Content-Type` the spec does not accept | Fixed |
| Missed: the body described as required when the spec says optional, and the reverse | Fixed |
| Missed: a duplicate table row; a required row deleted | Fixed |
| Missed: path parameter row removed; required query parameter removed from the curl URL; query parameter type changed | Fixed |
| Missed: overview Base URL or authentication changed | Fixed; the overview's own auth section was hidden by a `##### Authentication` heading copied from the spec's description, which the generator now demotes and the validator no longer mistakes for the section |
| Missed: Request Body section removed; Endpoint section removed while a field was invented | Fixed |
| `TODO`, `TBD`, `<insert …>`, `{{…}}` and lorem ipsum were warnings | Changed: errors |
| `last_reviewed: 2026-02-30` and dates in the future passed | Fixed |
| Every generated POST that returns 200 got a "POST returning 200" warning | Changed: that heuristic now applies to hand-written docs only, since generated statuses come from the spec and are checked against it |
| The curl URL used `value` for path parameters with no example | Fixed: shows `{name}`, with a warning to add an example; a real enum value `value` is kept |
| The summary did not say why a check was skipped | Fixed: each skip gives its reason; the summary separates passed, passed with warnings, skipped and failed |
| Errors appeared to go missing when many validators ran at once | Not reproduced; hardened anyway: each validator writes its report in one call and sets the exit code instead of exiting mid-write |
| Newlines and pipes in spec descriptions broke table rows; keywords next to `$ref` were ignored; deprecated fields were not marked; `last_reviewed` used the UTC date | Fixed |

Found while fixing:

- The bundled examples that `init --with-examples` copies to an adopter failed the OpenAPI check (backticked parameter names were not read, two docs left out the required `Idempotency-Key` header, one left out a 401 row, the spec's paging parameters had no defaults), and their owners were not in the owners registry. The repository's own `npm run validate` did not look at those folders. Fixed, and it now does.
- Hand-written docs that started from a template could drop sections without notice. The quality check now warns, for a doc that follows at least half of one template's sections.
- Vendor specs give numbers as strings in their own examples (Ably's `timestamp`, Vonage's `count`). The generator now shows them as the numbers their schema defines and says so in the doc.
